items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Zentralen Bußgeldbehörde Beispielsaarland.
items.computation: The attached Zustellungsurkunde (page 2) shows the notice was formally delivered on Saturday 2026-11-21. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (applied via § 46 OWiG/§ 43 StPO to this OWiG deadline), the day of delivery itself is not counted; the period begins the next day, 2026-11-22. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a two-week period ends with the day of the second week whose name corresponds to the day of the triggering event (Saturday). Counting two full weeks of 7 days each from the delivery date (21.11 -> 28.11 -> 05.12.2026) gives a nominal end date of Saturday 2026-12-05. Since that day is a Saturday, § 193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day. Monday 2026-12-07 is not a Saarland public holiday, so the Einspruch must reach the authority by 2026-12-07.

items.title: Pay the fine (Geldbuße, fee and delivery costs) once the notice is final
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE94 5901 0000 0006 6121 00.
items.computation: Payment is explicitly conditional on the Bescheid becoming rechtskräftig (final), which happens if no Einspruch is filed by the deadline computed above, i.e. at the end of 2026-12-07. Treating the entry into legal force as the triggering event, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB excludes that day from the count, so the two-week payment period begins 2026-12-08. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends on the day of the second week matching the name of the triggering day (Monday): 2026-12-07 + 14 days = Monday 2026-12-21, which is not a weekend day or a Saarland holiday, so no further shift is needed. This date only applies if no Einspruch is filed in time; if an Einspruch is lodged, this payment obligation does not (yet) arise.

warnings: The payment due date (2026-12-21) is only valid if no Einspruch is filed by 2026-12-07; filing an Einspruch suspends the payment obligation and changes the timeline.
The sender's email address ends in the placeholder domain "...beis.example", which is not a real, deliverable domain — verify the authority's actual contact details before relying on it.
